title: HLB: Benchmarking LLMs’ Humanlikeness in Language Use
reasoning: The paper presents a benchmark (HLB) to assess the humanlikeness of LLMs through 10 psycholinguistic experiments. While one experiment (E8: semantic illusion) uses a 'strong imposter' from the Bible (the 'Moses Illusion' task), the purpose is to evaluate linguistic processing and error detection rather than to benchmark religious, moral, or ethical values.
